sources.entry: HamsterBase Tasks - A tool to help organize ideas and build great things. Plan, organize, build and ship. (Demo, Source Code) AGPL-3.0 Docker

summary.one_liner: HamsterBase Tasks is an open-source, local-first task and idea organizer for planning, organizing and shipping projects, with an online web demo and self-hosted and Android options.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes an app meant to help creators capture ideas and plan work. It states that data is stored on the user's device so the app works immediately and offline, with changes syncing across devices such as phones and laptops when connected. It claims end-to-end encryption so developers cannot read decrypted data. It also says users own their data and can back it up and modify it freely. A web version is available as an online demo without registration. The README points to external pages for downloads and self-hosted deployment instructions, and to docs/android-build-instructions.md for building the Android app from source.
use_cases: track ideas and turn them into tasks
sync tasks between phone and laptop
build an Android task app from source
how_to_run: Try the web version at the online demo (no registration required)
For self-hosted deployment, follow the self-hosted guide linked in the README
To build the Android app, see docs/android-build-instructions.md
notable: Local-first design: data stored on device, works offline and syncs later
End-to-end encryption, so developers cannot access decrypted data
Durable, user-owned data with free backups
Monorepo with packages such as vite-plugin-istanbul and vscf
caveats: Self-hosted and download details are on external pages not included in the README
Android build requires separate instructions in a docs file
